name: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Tallahassee, FL · host Florida State · Apalachee Regional Park
headline: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 4 Alabama’s women won with 21 points behind a 1-2 from Caren Kiplagat (19:20.6) and Cynthia Jemutai, with No. 5 Florida second (74). Alabama’s men won too, 48 to 54 over No. 8 Florida, with No. 24 Tennessee third (120). Florida’s Kelvin Cheruiyot won the men’s race in 29:01.5, 0.7 seconds ahead of Alabama’s Dennis Kipruto.
